18:44 Local Time, 17:44 GMT, 23:14 IST: The reading being taken from both ends. Rizwan says, 'light is good for me'. But the umpires don't take that into account. They are walking off. If they don't come back in 16 minutes time, we will have stumps on day 2. The players are going off because of bad light pretty much like yesterday. England's day again so far! They have once again bossed the show. They were clinical with the ball and have been decent with the bat. The lead has swelled to 261 and that is a fat lead on this deck. We will bring you updates as and when we have them.

It is stumps on day 2. The day started with the final pair of Atkinson and Tongue frustrating Pakistan's bowlers for almost an hour. They stretched their first innings score to 290. And in reply Pakistan came up with another meek show. Only Azan Awais showed some spark. Babar played a couple of delightful shots before edging one to the cordon. Shakeel also showed some promise but that was short lived. They were one batter short as well thanks to the calf injury to Imam which ensured he didn't bat. Pakistan only bagged 110 runs and gave away a lead of 180 runs. England lost two early but Emilio Gay and Root steadied the ship before the latter was dismissed LBW once again! Brook survived an LBW scare off his first ball after he was given out wrongly. But the DRS saved him as the edge was a big one. England lead by 261! That's a big fat lead. They will look to bat at least two sessions tomorrow to throw this beyond Pakistan. We will be back as well to detail you proceedings of day 3. Bye bye for now...

10:15 Local Time, 09:15 GMT, 14:45 IST: Day 3 and a similar narrative stares Pakistan again. It has been hostility served on a platter to the visitors from day 1 of the tour. They just haven't been able to compete. Again they are well behind the 8-ball in thie game. England have been relentless with the ball and that has aided them to get a lead of more than 250 already. It is just day 3 and Pakistan maybe sent on a leather hunt if Brook survives the early phase. It is imperative that Pakistan starts well now else the result will be a mere formality.

Hello and Welcome to action on day 3. Lord's has always been a happy hunting ground for the pacers and it has again come true. The pacers have been able to extract every sort of help from the deck. Batters have been able to fight it out but big individual scores haven't been seen so far. Emilio Gay has gotten off to a start and has a chance to make it count. He did exceedingly well in the final session and will look to carry on in the same vein in the morning hours as well.

10:20 Local Time, 09:20 GMT, 14:50 IST: Uh oh! All the action can wait. It is raining! The start of play will be delayed in all likelihood. There is still more than 30 minutes to go. The covers are on and we will hopefully get enough time to see enough overs being bowled. The game has moved at a rampant pace and we certainly afford few overs being lost. Fingers crossed. We will update you with more nuggets.
10:55 Local Time, 09:55 GMT, 15:25 IST: The rain has gotten much heavier at Lord's and the latest forecast shows it continuing until 6 PM local. The covers are firmly on, stay tuned for further!

11:26 Local Time, 10:26 GMT, 15:56 IST: There's no change as the steady rain continues and the pitch is under the covers. The waiting game goes on, we'll bring you fresh updates as soon as the weather improves.
